pages.title: Contributing to the wiki
pages.summary: Prepare a model- and firmware-scoped contribution with a minimal sanitized hardware report and an appropriate documentation location.
pages.compatibility: Community process; examples of missing models may lag the current device matrix. Diagnostics require existing authorized access.

pages.title: Community contributors
pages.summary: Trace model reports and recipe changes to public contributions while retaining credit without importing personal inventories.
pages.compatibility: Attribution and provenance only; contributor credit does not establish compatibility or independent validation.

pages.title: Device families and support matrix
pages.summary: Separate Buildroot, Android and Yocto platforms before selecting a workflow, and resolve misleading retail and internal model names.
pages.compatibility: Fourteen dedicated model pages; Duo Max and Station Pro remain data gaps rather than supported devices.

pages.title: JBL Link Music with Alice
pages.summary: Identify the MediaTek, ARMv7, Yocto/systemd exception and distinguish its persistent data volume from factory material.
pages.compatibility: MT8516 reported as MT8167 in device-tree; kernel 4.4.22. AArch64 packages do not run; SSH and OTA adaptations remain unresolved.

pages.title: Station 2
pages.summary: Recognize the AXG retail Station 2 despite its station-midi identifier; record its Gowin LED panel and limited USB evidence separately.
pages.compatibility: Buildroot, kernel 4.9.68, NAND/UBI. Not retail Midi or Android Max. USB storage and RTL8153 reported; USB audio untested on this model.

pages.title: Station 3: Orion
pages.summary: Keep Orion identification limited to reported network observations; do not infer its chipset, operating system or a usable root route.
pages.compatibility: No documented root; DNS/TLS route rejected. Glagol TLS acceptance did not yield responses to older commands. Hardware and recovery remain unknown.

pages.title: Station first generation
pages.summary: Identify the Allwinner Android platform, verified-system constraints and model-specific boot recovery requirements before considering changes.
pages.compatibility: Tulip/R18, Android 6.0.1, kernel 3.10.65, eMMC. AliceBridge boot-image route is documented; Buildroot DNS and init recipes are not transferable.

pages.title: Station Lite: Micro
pages.summary: Baseline the Micro AXG platform, mixed kernel/userspace architecture, three-zone ring and board-revision-specific peripheral probes.
pages.compatibility: Micro v1.2 report: 64-bit kernel 4.9.68 with armhf Buildroot, NAND/UBI. Missing optional chips can explain failed probes without a fault.

pages.title: Station Lite 2: Plum
pages.summary: Distinguish Plum from Lite and Street, and retain the firmware cutoff separating old DNS access from the documented factory CA route.
pages.compatibility: AXG/A113X, kernel 4.9.68 aarch64, armhf Buildroot. Post-21 October 2026 access is model-specific; AliceBridge exact tested builds are incompletely recorded.

pages.title: Station Max
pages.summary: Treat yandexstation_2 as Android Max, not retail Station 2, and recognize production-shell and verified-boot restrictions.
pages.compatibility: Amlogic TV-class, Android 9/YaOS, kernel 4.9.113; AVB, dm-verity and SELinux enforced. Network ADB shell is not root; no confirmed root route.

pages.title: Station Midi: Cucumber
pages.summary: Identify Cucumber's A5/eMMC platform and protect the shared microphone clock when diagnosing its audio and peripheral interfaces.
pages.compatibility: Kernel 5.4.180, Buildroot 2023.11.1, not AXG station-midi. Reported microphone capture is 96 kHz; changing the PDM rate can disable Alice hearing.

pages.title: Station Mini first generation
pages.summary: Keep Mini 1's older Buildroot, gesture sensor, I2C ring and SELinux constraints separate from later Mini generations.
pages.compatibility: AXG, kernel 4.9.68, Buildroot 2017.02. Page reports A/B boot and writable rootfs; do not infer slot targets from its abbreviated partition table.

pages.title: Station Mini 2
pages.summary: Record Mini 2's six-zone sysfs ring, optional clock segments, separate DAC and flash-vendor differences without assuming a verified animation format.
pages.compatibility: AXG, kernel 4.9.68, armhf Buildroot 2020.02.1. NAND variants differ; six-zone .led column interpretation is explicitly unverified.

pages.title: Station Mini 3 Pro: Pickle
pages.summary: Separate Pickle from Bergamot and plan around the report that only data-volume changes survive reboot, not rootfs startup modifications.
pages.compatibility: A4, kernel 5.4.242, Buildroot 2023.11.1, NAND/UBI and enforcing SELinux. Existing-root persistence is described; current root acquisition is not.

pages.title: Station Mini 3: Bergamot
pages.summary: Identify Bergamot's framebuffer ring and firmware-specific access route without borrowing Pickle persistence behavior.
pages.compatibility: AXG, kernel 4.9.68, armhf Buildroot. Six-zone BGR framebuffer; newer firmware requires the separate factory guide and a still-vulnerable factory image.

pages.title: Station Street: Mango
pages.summary: Recognize the battery-powered, fully 32-bit Mango platform and exclude AArch64 package assumptions.
pages.compatibility: A1/Cortex-A35, armv7l kernel 5.15.137 and Buildroot 2023.11.1. Battery, RGBW status and charging interfaces differ from AXG models.

pages.title: Yandex Smart Home Hub: Saturn
pages.summary: Route Saturn to hub diagnostics rather than speaker recipes: its Zigbee, Bluetooth and IR roles have no conventional audio pipeline.
pages.compatibility: AXG, kernel 4.9.68, Buildroot 2020.02.1; no speaker or microphones. Generic Zigbee-coordinator reuse remains a research question.

pages.title: Yandex Station Extended overview
pages.summary: Find the community's access, recipes, hardware and internals sections while retaining its owner-only and privacy boundaries.
pages.compatibility: Navigation and project orientation only; broad support badges must be narrowed by model and firmware evidence.

pages.title: Quasar firmware architecture
pages.summary: Trace BusyBox startup, the Quasar launcher and maind roles without changing services or trusting synthesized ABI properties.
pages.compatibility: Primarily Lite Quasar 3.21 on Amlogic/Buildroot; not a service map for Android or Yocto. maind getprop can misreport application architecture.

pages.title: Directives and capabilities
pages.summary: Diagnose legacy Struct versus typed protobuf directive encoding and distinguish state-reporting channels before any controlled integration experiment.
pages.compatibility: Mini 2 firmware 0.369.1.46 evidence; typed payloads require PayloadRaw and a matching DirectiveType. Not an Orion API contract.

pages.title: Platform pitfalls
pages.summary: Account for reduced BusyBox tools, stale ALSA and hotplug configuration, fragile module ABI and competing mDNS publishers.
pages.compatibility: Mostly Lite observations. Older TLS and plaintext-endpoint claims are not universal; newer Plum/Bergamot and Orion documentation narrows them.

pages.title: Network interfaces and services
pages.summary: Interpret the documented Lite service map and DNS fallbacks without performing discovery or treating open ports as an authorization boundary.
pages.compatibility: Lite Quasar 3.21 with access already enabled. Glagol protocol details are deferred upstream; ports and command support vary by platform.

pages.title: Cross-compiling station software
pages.summary: Select a build target from kernel architecture and actual ELF dependencies, build on the host and plan a bounded data-volume deployment.
pages.compatibility: Static AArch64 musl for supported 64-bit kernels; ARMv7 for Street/JBL. Vendor-library integration may require armhf and model-specific glibc limits.

pages.title: Alice voice pipeline
pages.summary: Separate local wake-word processing from cloud ASR and dialogue, and diagnose capture, recognition and playback as different failure stages.
pages.compatibility: Quasar 3.21 observations and labeled inferences; capture-device numbers and rates are model-dependent, especially Cucumber's 96 kHz path.

pages.title: AirPlay with Shairport Sync
pages.summary: Diagnose an existing AirPlay installation by version, FIFO, audio ownership and session state; expose Quasar interruption before considering hooks or patches.
pages.compatibility: Mini 3: Shairport Sync 4.3.7 and nqptp 1.2.4 fix. Station 2 development-version techniques are separate evidence; base package installation is undocumented.

pages.title: Fastfetch station display
pages.summary: Plan a minimal information display using compatible binaries and optional, reviewed USB helpers without leaking host or network identifiers.
pages.compatibility: Published binary is AArch64. USB rows depend on a separately installed OTG helper; reported OS architecture does not prove userspace ABI.

pages.title: Recipe index
pages.summary: Choose a focused recipe from the desired outcome and its documented model coverage instead of treating all modifications as a prerequisite chain.
pages.compatibility: Recipe claims vary from one tested model to open research; each destination's prerequisites and caveats take priority.

pages.title: LED interfaces and animations
pages.summary: Select the model's sysfs or framebuffer interface, preview a short low-brightness effect and preserve normal status indication.
pages.compatibility: Lite and Mini 2 sysfs differ from Mini 3 and Station 2 framebuffers. Zone counts, pixel order and animation formats are not interchangeable.

pages.title: Custom LLM and backend alternatives
pages.summary: Compare the cloud-speech Quasar Bridge hybrid with a replacement quasard backend, including voice privacy, lost features and reversible endpoint plans.
pages.compatibility: Bridge reported on Station 2/Quasar 3.21. quasard describes older JSON and 3.x protobuf protocols; model-wide operation and current TLS compatibility are not established.

pages.title: Custom sounds and streams
pages.summary: Prefer a quiet one-shot media test through the existing audio pipeline before optional startup sounds or reversible system-sound replacement.
pages.compatibility: Native maind/GStreamer Buildroot recipes; not Android Max/gen1 or audio-less Saturn. System-sound hot reload is unverified.

pages.title: Standalone use without Yandex
pages.summary: Frame standalone reuse as a bounded experiment, not a proven subscription-unlock method or a reason to disable Quasar automatically.
pages.compatibility: Subscription-blocked stations are explicitly unverified. Bluetooth, AirPlay and third-party Spotify Connect claims do not establish general offline operation.

pages.title: USB host peripherals
pages.summary: Plan model-checked powered-hub experiments with an independent recovery path, compatible kernel modules and safe audio attenuation.
pages.compatibility: Lite Micro and Station 2 AXG/kernel 4.9.68 only. USB audio evidence is Lite-specific; matching vermagic alone does not make modules safe.

pages.title: YAM and BetterYAM
pages.summary: Review daemon exposure, plugin permissions, architecture and update policy before manually installing or enabling a model-compatible plugin manager.
pages.compatibility: Snapshot: YAM 0.1.15 for AArch64 kernels; BetterYAM 0.1.18 only Mini 1 with ARMv7 daemon. Both expose an unauthenticated LAN API and lack installed autostart.

pages.title: Getting started by model
pages.summary: Choose a model-specific access assessment first; do not import the wiki's root-and-OTA sequence as automatic execution policy.
pages.compatibility: Model and firmware routing guide, not proof that every listed flow is independently tested or safe for a different build.

pages.title: Packages with yse
pages.summary: Review Entware versus .yap sources, space, command collisions and trust before preparing a reversible single-package installation plan.
pages.compatibility: Buildroot with existing authorized root; .yap registry builds are AArch64 only. Street needs ARMv7 Entware; Android support is not supplied by this recipe.

pages.title: Recovery and rollback
pages.summary: Triage boot loops and regressions using existing access, then plan the smallest reversible removal of the last change before reset or flash consideration.
pages.compatibility: Primarily Amlogic/Buildroot. UART unlock is untested; reliable USB-burning entry and images are not documented. Reset does not undo rootfs changes.

pages.title: Mini 3 factory-to-retail access assessment
pages.summary: Explain Bergamot's factory-image dependency, retail trust-store target and separate data-volume persistence requirements without reproducing the unlock payload.
pages.compatibility: Mini 3 after 21 October 2026, only while the older factory recovery image remains usable. Not Mini 3 Pro; firmware-specific hashes must not be generalized.

pages.title: Lite 2 factory-to-retail access assessment
pages.summary: Assess Plum's documented CA-bundle modification as a manual trust-boundary change requiring exact volume identification and original-file recovery.
pages.compatibility: Verified upstream only for Lite 2/Plum. MTD and UBI numbering is not portable; Android models are excluded and Mini 3 has a separate guide.

pages.title: AliceBridge Android access assessment
pages.summary: Separate reported AliceBridge model tests from server profile availability, experimental Shizuku networking and first-generation boot-image writes.
pages.compatibility: Main flow requires ARM64 Android 12L+ and compatible root support; Shizuku on Android 13+ is experimental. Lite 1, Mini 1, Midi and Lite 2 are reported tested, not every profile.

pages.title: JBL USB startup access assessment
pages.summary: Describe the reported transient service-USB access and persistent network exposure as a model-specific manual procedure, not an automatic catcher.
pages.compatibility: JBL Link Music with Alice, reported firmware dated 19 December 2025. Other marker roles, ARMv7 SSH support and OTA blocking remain unverified.

pages.title: DNS access assessment
pages.summary: Assess historical DNS-assisted setup against the exact model and firmware; make reset, router scope and third-party trust changes explicit before any owner action.
pages.compatibility: Older supported Buildroot builds only; local-stand test coverage is narrower than the general table. Newer Plum/Bergamot, Android Max/gen1 and Orion need separate treatment.

pages.title: SSH persistence and OTA assessment
pages.summary: Replace unsafe empty-password assumptions with owner-managed key-only, pinned-host-key access; discuss OTA changes separately from establishing SSH.
pages.compatibility: Upstream startup and OTA examples target writable-rootfs Buildroot. Pickle, Android and JBL differ; Dropbear architecture claims conflict with the toolchain page.
